proof.criterion: C1: GET /api/v1/references stays 200 and lists every known edge, ?to= and ?from=, while graph_edges holds an edge whose other end is an unknown kind
proof.surface: Local Dispatch harness: packages/dispatch/e2e/run-server.sh on rootless Postgres 17 + pgvector (/legion/harness, database dispatch_proof, port 18777), agent bearer e2e-token, future rows inserted by psql
proof.command: bash /legion/harness/proof.sh head (curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer e2e-token' $H/api/v1/references?to=dispatch://CORE-1 and ?from=dispatch://OPS-1/comment/<id>); outputs in https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/2201#issuecomment-6400482181
proof.observed: ?to= 200 with mentions artifact (CORE/design-notes), mentions comment, attached_to spec, no future; ?from= 200 with the mention of CORE-1 only
proof.negativeControl: Same database served by a binary built at test commit 79a4d10bda98: both reads 500, server log 'graph node kind "future" is not addressable'

proof.criterion: C2: referenced_by_count counts the rows its list shows
proof.command: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer e2e-token' $H/api/v1/issues/CORE-1 | jq .referenced_by_count, beside jq '.edges|length' of C1's ?to= read
proof.observed: referenced_by_count 3 = listed 3 = the fixture's known citers (document mention, comment mention, attached spec)
proof.negativeControl: Test-commit binary on the same rows: referenced_by_count 4 while its list read is a 500

proof.criterion: C3: GET /api/v1/artifacts/{id}/references skips an unknown kind on both halves and keeps known unresolved targets
proof.command: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer e2e-token' $H/api/v1/artifacts/<doc>/references, with incoming and outgoing future rows, then with only the outgoing one
proof.observed: 200; outgoing [artifact CORE/missing unresolved, issue CORE-1 unresolved], referenced_by [the comment]; with only the outgoing future row, outgoing is the same two entries
proof.negativeControl: Test-commit binary: 500 with both rows; with only the outgoing future row, outgoing lists {kind: future, to_id: x#y}

proof.criterion: C4: an agent's dispatch read keeps Referenced by and Links
proof.command: env -u DISPATCH_TOKEN_FILE DISPATCH_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18777 DISPATCH_TOKEN=e2e-token bun packages/envoy-client/bin/dispatch.ts read --issue CORE-1
proof.observed: Referenced by: lists the document mention, the comment mention and the attached spec; Links: none (CORE-1 links nothing); no unavailable row
proof.negativeControl: Test-commit binary: 'Referenced by:' then '- unavailable: internal server error'

proof.criterion: C5: a person's issue page lists the citations with a matching count
proof.surface: Signed-in dashboard, Playwright Chromium against the real server and database (packages/dispatch/e2e)
proof.command: cd packages/dispatch && bun run build:web && bunx playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts references.e2e.ts --project chromium -g 'skip an edge of a node kind'
proof.observed: 1 passed: header Referenced by (2), panel lists Message · OPS issue, no 'Referenced by unavailable.'; whole references.e2e.ts on chromium 10 passed
proof.negativeControl: Same test at test commit 79a4d10bda98 fails: the page shows button 'Referenced by (3)' and the click on 'Referenced by (2)' times out

trickyParts: nodeLoaders is the one source of node kinds: resolveNodes looks a kind up there and skips one with no entry; nodeKinds (sorted keys) is bound in BacklinkCounts (from_kind = any($3), exclusion moved to $4) and in Outgoing (e.to_kind = any($2)). INFRA-366 must add a block entry to nodeLoaders, which makes block edges resolve, count and list in one step.
Outgoing filters by kind, never by a missing join, so a known issue target and a dangling known artifact still list as unresolved entries.
deviations: Simplify pass applied one finding (fixed $3 placeholder in BacklinkCounts), folded into the unpushed fix commit; every check and proof ran after it at 28dcd7a1.

Harness: rootless Postgres 17.11 + pgvector 0.8.0 from Debian packages at /legion/harness (setup.sh, env.sh; lanes per LEGION_ROLE: implementer 18777/dispatch_impl_e2e, tester 18877/dispatch_test_e2e, reviewer 18977/dispatch_review_e2e). Its cluster is initdb --locale=C, so api's TestIssueRanksStayOrderedPastLowercaseDigitsAndProductionShapedMoves refuses to run there by design (it needs a non-byte-order collation); unrelated to this change, CI's Postgres runs it.
